name: io.github.peculiar-systems/invoicein
description: Read and validate any European e-invoice a business receives — XRechnung, UBL, CII, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF, Peppol BIS 3, FatturaPA, KSeF FA(3) — into canonical EN 16931 JSON with plain-language fix hints (EN/DE/PL/IT/FR), PDF, CSV and DATEV export.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: InvoiceIn API key. Optional: without it the demo quota of 20 invoices a day per IP applies.
